description: Husenbeth Services UG develops a product, Breaby. Breaby combines air data inside buildings and outer data to give nudges towards healthy indoor spaces and increased energy efficiency. As a body tracker is tracking body data, for improved fitness, Breaby does this for our indoor spaces to improve the air we breathe. The key advantage of Open Data from space lies in the wide scope of available air quality measures from earth observation and the long forecasting intervals which cannot be provided by other sources. Combined with behavioural science to implement nudges, Breaby is a unique solution. To enter the market, the focus is on the B2B-case for healthy workplaces. The first version consists of an IoT-Device (internet of things) and a smartphone app. The composed data allows Breaby not only to give behavioural insights but also recommendations for other technical solutions – which brings many business opportunities. Later in the future, Breaby could become a platform for healthy indoor air management, being integrated with smart building infrastructure (via Matter standard). The target market shall be expanded to B2C in the future.

description: The Sustainability Management Software „Caribou – ESG Toolbox“ offers B2B clients the opportunity to gather, evaluate, plan, display and report all relevant sustainability data and activities. Caribou strives to make sustainability an integral part of each business. This is not possible without adequate materiality analysis and data-driven decision-making. Current sustainability directives (such as Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive, Supply Chain Act etc.) require companies to evaluate sustainability-related impacts, risks and opportunities to create mitigation strategies and report on the current sustainability status and plans. Here the Caribou software comes into play providing a user-friendly, unified space for all sustainability-related data and decision-making. Caribou aims at utilizing Environmental Observation, as well as spatial datasets to enhance company operations and supply chain transparency. By mapping large company premises and supply chain spots in proximity to nearby biodiversity-sensitive and endangered areas as well as cultural sites, the integration aims to assess potential risks and suggest strategic alternatives in the business operations, product development and logistics. The founders are full-time sustainability experts from „Greenativity – Sustainability Consulting'' together with a Business Developer and IT specialist. The Caribou team consists of 4 co-founders and a large network of sustainability and business development specialists.

name: Circe. Smart Navigations Solutions S.L.
description: Circe – Smart Navigation Solutions S.L. is a company oriented to the development of security solutions for geolocation systems. Commercial satellite navigation signals are not secure, and this makes GNSS receivers vulnerable. Most of the modern devices and systems that use GNSS are not protected, and on the other hand, there are few solutions on the market, and most are oriented to the defense sector. At Circe we have developed software capable of detecting radio frequency interference signals. The core of the software is a machine-learning-based algorithm trained to detect and classify attacks on GNSS receivers, with high precision and in real time.

name: CIRCUITS INTEGRATED HELLAS
description: Circuits Integrated Hellas is revolutionizing the Performance and Efficiency of Phased Array Antennas with its Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuit (MMIC). It offers a full set of “Co-design” Circuital Elements, all integrated in a unified package with autonomous operation, minimizing the need of PCBs. The revolutionary design, combined with advanced IC materials (GaAs/GaN) results in a x3 times smaller, x2 times cheaper and +20% Efficient MMIC that will empower Next Gen Phased Arrays in SATCOM. The MMIC market for the SATCOM is currently ~2bn Euros and is expected to be doubled in the next decade. Additional similar use-cases such as 5G, defence increase potentially to 5bn Euros. CI aspires to become a leading chip consultant, design house and supplier in GaN/GaAs based designs for the SATCOM industry.

name: Clarity AI UG (haftungsbeschränkt)
description: Clarity AI, founded by Joana Süssenbach and Boris Idesman is developing EnviroTrust: a climate risk intelligence platform for the European real estate market. They aim to provide comprehensive analyses of five core climate hazards: flood, heat, wildfire, wind damage, and air quality. Their target segments include homebuyers, real estate investors, insurance companies, real estate agents, and banks. The company's innovative approach heavily relies on space technology, specifically integrating Earth Observation datasets such as ERA5 for temperature and wind, CAMS for air quality, and EEA for flood hazards. They also use high-resolution terrain data (e.g., Copernicus Urban Atlas) and layers to deliver hyperlocal risk assessments for real estate properties. This downstream application of space data offers significant advantages, including cost-effective data access, scalability across Europe, and continuous, timely updates due to frequent satellite coverage. EnviroTrust's proprietary algorithms process this data to generate hazard profiles and understandable, user friendly environment risk index, making complex environmental information accessible and actionable for real estate decision making.
